ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.CareLoop_Bypass_Validation) && OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(BP_Systolic__c)), OR(BP_Systolic__c < 60, BP_Systolic__c > 260)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(SpO2__c)), OR(SpO2__c < 50, SpO2__c > 100)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Temperature__c)), OR(Temperature__c < 30, Temperature__c > 45)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Pulse__c)), OR(Pulse__c < 20, Pulse__c > 250)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: One or more vitals are outside a plausible range. Please re-check the reading.
